## Statement

Let $T(n) = n/2$ for even $n$ and $T(n) = 3n + 1$ for odd $n$. For each $n \geq 1$, some iterate of $T$ at $n$ is 1. See [the survey](https://example.org/survey).

## Remarks

Lagarias keeps an [annotated bibliography](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0309224) of the problem.
